cross_verification.note_en: Directly browsed Nepal's Department of Passports official site (nepalpassport.gov.np) 'documents required' pages for both domestic (/process/-8) and abroad (/process/-9) applications. Standard adult e-Passport applications are processed via in-person biometric capture at enrollment centers, so no separate submitted photo (with size/background spec) is itemized for the general case. The only explicit photo mention found is for the special case of a minor born abroad to Nepali parents applying for a first passport, which requires 'नाबालकको हालै खिचेको पासपोर्ट आकारको फोटो २ प्रति' (2 copies of a recently taken passport-size photo of the minor) — quantity only, no mm/background spec given. The Embassy of Nepal, Washington DC (us.nepalembassy.gov.np, official) states photos are taken in-person at the embassy and directs applicants to nepalpassport.gov.np for further detail, which was searched extensively without finding a published numeric spec page. Commonly cited figures (35×45mm, white background) appear only on third-party photo-service sites and were not confirmed against an official .gov.np source, so are excluded here.
